title: The Radiation Oncology Registry and Biosample Repository
summary: The goal of this study is to establish a registry and biosample repository (defined as blood, urine, and tumor specimens) in patients with a cancer and/or benign tumor diagnosis undergoing radiotherapy.
criteria:
* Anyone age 18 and above with a cancer and/or benign tumor diagnosis undergoing radiotherapy
* Able to sign consent
sponsor: Abramson Cancer Center at Penn Medicine
